HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may stay outside the crop, and fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.

free_design.Place: a private guesthouse bedroom with a low cushioned reading chair beside a sunlit open window
free_design.Activity: she softly sings a remembered melody from an unmarked folded booklet; the small shoulder cape of her sleep set has caught on the chair corner and opened away from her arms as she leans forward
free_design.Pose: sitting on the front of the chair with both feet on the floor; her right and left arms each extend from their own shoulder, elbows beside her waist, each hand holds one edge of the booklet in front of her chest
free_design.Framing: front three-quarter seated portrait from the top of her head to mid-thigh, camera at her eye level, her face and both hands visible
free_design.Outfit: an opaque plum satin lingerie-inspired wrap-cup bralette with paired narrow ribbon ties, scalloped petal-cut tap pants and a tiny matching shoulder cape attached at the collar; the cape hangs open from catching on the chair while the fitted opaque bra and pants stay securely in place, bare shoulders, midriff and upper thighs
